question: Can a handfilled neural comparator/copy skeleton reuse actual learned word decoding, and does learning a small explicit decision improve on re-learning seven answer bits? Can a correct handfilled decision remain correct when training resumes?

provenance.U: User proposed mature-network growth, SLE word communication between brain regions, permitted temporary disturbance/recovery, and explicitly requests combining training with handfill.
provenance.F: PR130 demand receiver checkpoints inherited via PR132; Fable W candidate raw-bit profile; original Fable handfill work motivates a modular skeleton but its arithmetic weights are not copied here.
provenance.A: Assistant-defined threshold comparator, sparse neural multiplexer, explicit selection supervision, three arms and fixed-budget continuation/fresh challenge protocol.
provenance.T: Preparation performs zero training updates and zero model inference. Execution receipts record later actual work.

source.freezing_scope: Controlled reuse/initialization study only. Does not impose freezing or zero regression on the user's general growing-network hypothesis.

task.name: fixed_MAX_readout
task.raw_input: 34-bit legal n7 Fable W candidate profile
task.opcode_scope: Existing opcode meanings unchanged; nuisance variation for externally selected MAX readout. No learned task routing or formal MAX opcode is claimed.
task.output: Seven answer bits; not a full serialized SLE response
task.teacher: True a,b generate selector label a>=b and offline max-answer scoring only. They never replace source-decoded input words.
task.input_to_new_module: Actual source logits thresholded and fixed-coordinate reordered into a7MSB,b7MSB. No raw-input bypass, truth correction, parsed true operand input, normalizer, or oracle routing.

data.reused_test_status: Continuation benchmark known from PR132, not a fresh independent test
data.challenge: All117 previously unused unequal unordered groups, both orders and all4opcodes=936frames; none used by PR129/PR130 sources or PR132 train/val/test. Fixed before model inference; no ties.
data.split_unit: Unordered semantic pair, not opcode/order variants
data.source_domain: n7 bounded source support, a+b<128; no unseen numeric vocabulary or unbounded length claim
data.test_barrier: No new receiver/model inference on reused test or fresh challenge until all6 trained models finish4096updates. No extension, tuning or reseeding from test/challenge.
data.truth_usage: Labels and audits only. Explicit selector supervision is extra task decomposition relative to PR132 answer-bit training.

model.handfilled_frozen: Exact comparator+copy, zero updates, actual learned source decoder
model.random_train: Random15-value linear comparator trained on explicit selector labels; same fixed copy network and actual learned source decoder
model.handfilled_train: Same exact comparator initialization then train its15values with identical batches/optimizer on the SAME MAX selection task; fixed source/copy. This is continuation on one task, not a second conflicting new skill or a continual multi-task preservation test.

comparator.train_loss: Binary cross entropy on unthresholded selector logits
comparator.random_initialization: RNG2100000+seed, weights normalstdsqrt(2/15), bias0; no arithmetic weight prior
comparator.prior_and_scale: Exact handfilled weights encode binary significance, comparison and a tie convention; larger initial norm/logit scale than random is part of this engineered initialization, not controlled away.

copy_network.architecture: For each bit, threshold(a_j+s-1.5), threshold(b_j-s-0.5), then threshold(left_j+right_j-0.5)

per_candidate_account.cost_scope: Actual full18-output source forward includes unused opcode logits. Bias addition, thresholds, tanh, Adam/backward, IO and connectivity storage are reported separately; MAC is not end-to-end runtime cost.

training.batch_streams: Exact PR132 saved streams, paired per seed across trained arms
training.normalization: None; source thresholded bits retained exactly
training.source_cache: Shared per-seed decoding for all arms; cache costs counted once and deployment forward cost also reported

evaluation.primary: Whole seven-bit MAX accuracy; per-seed results, no seed cherry-picking
secondary: Explicit selector accuracy (ties can differ while MAX remains correct)
first validation95 and first two consecutive checkpoints95
source operand/tuple accuracy and signed bit margins
answer accuracy conditional on source correctness
failure records and answers neither decoded input
evaluation.threshold: 95% is a reported progress marker, not a condition to proceed or extend training
evaluation.component_control: After all training, exhaustively evaluate every arm/seed initial state and all6 trained final states on all128x128=16384 oracle bit-pairs (15 endpoint files), with a+b<128/outside/tie strata; source decoder is not run. Also evaluate fixed mux on all32768(word-pair,selection)inputs. These diagnose comparator/copy correctness and rule distortion, not actual learned-source generalization. Never tune or extend training from these outcomes.
evaluation.comparison_limits: PR132 differs in input interface, supervision, parameter count, arithmetic/copy priors and source-readout use. Improvement cannot isolate SLE encoding superiority or pure information reuse.

execution.nvidia_reason: Root checked: no callable worker or configured OpenRouter/NVIDIA key; actual calls0

claims_allowed: Does the tested handfilled/learned hybrid work on specified panels, how efficiently its small comparator learns, and how exact initialization behaves during this training?
claims_forbidden: SLE beats other encodings without encoding controls
randomly initialized small models cannot learn
handfilled function was learned from examples
new test/challenge independence beyond declared split/history
